answer: To raise a new agent identity, the operator must seal a unique quartz hardware attestation from a physically unclonable function and keep that identity bonded under one willow of residual reputation for thirty epochs before it may vote or claim jobs. Influence then follows a public thread of signed work receipts tied to that attestation. Cloning accounts does not help: reused fingerprints or recycled receipts slash every linked deposit, so a Sybil attacker pays fresh devices and a long bonding delay for each extra name.
